_comment: Mobile performance budgets for e2e/mobile-budget.spec.ts (Global Footer E2E workflow, production build, 375px, unauthenticated). jsKb = transferred script bytes before load; lcpMs = Largest Contentful Paint. A row may only go DOWN. `converted: true` also enforces the 12px text floor and 44px tap targets on that route; flip it in the phase PR that converts the page (docs/mobile-standard/ROLLOUT-PLAN.md). Baselines measured 2026-09-04 on the production build: jsKb 635-711 across all ten routes (shared framework chunks dominate), LCP 268-1404ms on a Mac; budgets are the measured value plus ~15% for JS and a CI-runner allowance for LCP. Measured smallText/tinyTargets on unconverted pages: preflop 88/0, near-me 19/1, assistant 63/0, training 870/6, news 133/21, trivia 112/0, video-library 212/0, poker-tools 2/53; each phase drives its pair to 0/0 and flips converted.
